forum.title: Unable to add x-cube-spn5 package into latest version of CubeMX
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @JWhit15

Based on the description in [x-nucleo-ihm05a1\_quick\_start\_guide.pdf](https://www.st.com/resource/en/product_presentation/x-nucleo-ihm05a1_quick_start_guide.pdf) and  [Getting started with the X-CUBE-SPN5 bipolar stepper motor driver software expansion for STM32Cube](https://www.st.com/resource/en/user_manual/um1927-getting-started-with-the-xcubespn5-bipolar-stepper-motor-driver-software-expansion-for-stm32cube-stmicroelectronics.pdf)

![GhofraneGSOURI_0-1776423407918.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/2492267a-a36a-25ec-0917-aa8a85c962b7.png "GhofraneGSOURI_0-1776423407918.png")

All you need to do is downloading the **X-CUBE-SPN5 :[X-CUBE-SPN5 | Product - STMicroelectronics](https://www.st.com/en/embedded-software/x-cube-spn5.html#section-get-software-table)**

Then open the preconfigured example project provided inside the expansion package for your specific Nucleo board and IDE, then adjust the configuration files such as l6208\_target\_config.h or main.c, build the project, and flash it to the board.

![GhofraneGSOURI_1-1776423608389.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/b443b304-2c8e-5a1e-671a-e753ad591e20.png "GhofraneGSOURI_1-1776423608389.png")

![GhofraneGSOURI_2-1776423627008.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/acb2b714-5711-ba26-d0c0-629b7bd83db6.png "GhofraneGSOURI_2-1776423627008.png")
forum.content_text:
Hello,

The latest version of STM32CubeMX no longer lists x-cube-spn5 as an available package.

Could someone help me how to use a X-Nucleo-IHM05A1 expansion board with the latest tools please?
forum.author: JWhit15
